page.overview:
Who is Matt Decker?

Commodore Matthew "Matt" Decker was a 23rd century Human male Starfleet flag officer assigned as the commanding officer of the .

In 2245, Captain Decker was assigned to the newly launched USS Constellation as her commanding officer. He saw the ship through three five-year missions. ( )

In 2261, the was scheduled to rendezvous with the Constellation to deliver a vaccine to the colonists on Epsilon Indi III who were fighting off a pandemic. However, they were delayed by a rescue mission for Lieutenant Erica Ortegas. Captain Christopher Pike ordered Una Chin-Riley to contact Decker and inform him that the Enterprise had an emergency situation, but planned to rendezvous with the Constellation on schedule. ()

After being promoted to commodore in 2263, Decker chose to remain in command of the Constellation. ( commemorative plaque)
